title: Sherlock + Academy
titleNative: シャーロック＋アカデミー
synopsis: The need for detectives has dramatically increased in response to the increasing number of violent crimes. This year, a boy and a girl enter Marimine Detective Academy, an ultra-exclusive school, and the only one in Japan that offers the "National Detective License." The boy is Misaki Fujisaki, the grandson of the man who was once known as the "Crime King." The girl is Shia E. Hazeldine, the adopted daughter of the man known as the "Detective King." These two descendants of sworn enemies will meet each other by chance! And as their school days begin, an incident occurs right from the entrance ceremony!? Moreover, for some reason, Fujisaki's score is higher than Shia's, even though she supposedly solved the mystery first... "I challenge you!" "Don't regret this, princess." This is a unique academy story where students compete to find the truth. This is intellectual excitement at its highest peak! (Source: MFBunko J, translated)

Nozomu sends him along his way only to be approached by Tenkou, who is searching for his Master. Nozomu reunites Ichiyou and Tenkou; (and their abusive relationship), and gets a view of another world. The two men are on a journey to find the Gods. synopsis: A legendary god-tier game, "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", features an unprecedented 1,021 playable job classes and over 400 different endings! The more you play, the stronger you become, unlocking new abilities and rare items. One dedicated gamer (PN: Zephyrus) finds himself reincarnated as the protagonist of this very game! Overjoyed at the chance to experience it in real life, he immediately enrolls in the Labyrinth Academy—the game's main stage. Armed with his extensive knowledge of the game's mechanics, he aims to obtain the ultimate class: Hero. Not only that, but he also guides his timid childhood friend toward the Alchemist class, allowing the two of them to breeze through the academy's curriculum and rapidly level up! Powerful jobs, legendary loot, and epic rewards—secured at lightning speed! (Source: TO Books, translated)

title: Mimi's Tales of Terror
titleNative: ミミの怪談
synonyms: Las historias de fantasmas de Mimi
synopsis: University student Mimi and her boyfriend Naoto encounter one chilling mystery after another. There’s the enigmatic neighbor woman dressed in black from head to toe—but if she’s so odd, why does it seems like there are many others like her? Then, whose eyes track Mimi’s movements from the cemetery next door? And why does a bizarre red circle drawn on a basement wall change with each passing day? Nine scary stories that really happened, drawn from the famed collection of urban legends Shin Mimibukuro (New Earmuffs), and adapted into manga by horror genius Junji Ito! Chapter 1: On the Utility Pole Chapter 2: The Woman Next Door Chapter 3: Rustling in the Grass Chapter 4: Grave Placement Chapter 5: Seashore Chapter 6: Just the Two of Us Chapter 7: Scarlet Circle Chapter 8: Sign in the Field Chapter 9: Monster Prop (Source: VIZ Media)
